```{r, include=FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("BiocManager")
}
BiocManager::install(c("clusterProfiler", "EnhancedVolcano"))
BiocManager::install("DESeq2")
BiocManager::install(c("edgeR", "sytemPipeR", "org.At.tair.db"))

if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("remotes")
}
remotes::install_github("tgirke/systemPipeRdata", lib = "data", build = TRUE, force = TRUE, upgrade = "never")

lapply(c(
  "docopt", "DT", "pheatmap", "GenomicFeatures", "DESeq2",
  "edgeR", "systemPipeR", "systemPipeRdata", "BiocStyle", "GO.db", "dplyr",
  "tidyr", "stringr", "Rqc", "QuasR", "ape", "clusterProfiler", "biomaRt", "EnhancedVolcano", "org.At.tair.db"
), require, character.only = TRUE)

fq_path <- systemPipeRdata::pathList()$fastqdir
fq_files <- list.files(fq_path)
head(fq_files)
```

## Q1
```{r}
meta_data <- read.table(
     system.file("extdata/param/targetsPE.txt", package="systemPipeRdata"), 
     header = TRUE)

meta <- lapply(meta_data, function(x) gsub("./data/", fq_path, x))
library(data.table)
meta <- as.data.table(meta)
DT::datatable(meta)
```


## Q2
```{r, message=FALSE}
library(Rqc)
qc <- rqc(path = fq_path, pattern = ".fastq.gz", openBrowser=FALSE, outdir="outputs")

rqcCycleQualityBoxPlot(qc[1:12]) + theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightblue"))
rqcCycleQualityBoxPlot(qc[13:24]) + theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightblue"))
rqcCycleQualityBoxPlot(qc[25:36]) + theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightblue"))


rqcCycleBaseCallsLinePlot(qc[1:12]) + theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightblue"))
rqcCycleBaseCallsLinePlot(qc[13:24]) + theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightblue"))
rqcCycleBaseCallsLinePlot(qc[25:36]) + theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightblue"))
```

## Q3
```{r, message=FALSE}
library(stringr)
library(QuasR)
files1 <- meta$FileName1
files2 <- meta$FileName2
dir.create("outputs/processedFastq", recursive = TRUE)
out_files1 <- paste0("outputs/processedFastq/processed_", basename(files1))
out_files2 <- paste0("outputs/processedFastq/processed_", basename(files2))
preprocessReads(files1, out_files1, nBases = 1, 
                truncateEndBases = 3, 
                Lpattern = "GCCCGGGTAA")
preprocessReads(files2, out_files2, nBases = 1, 
                truncateEndBases = 3, 
                Lpattern = "GCCCGGGTAA")
meta$FileName1 <- out_files1
meta$FileName2 <- out_files2
```

## Q4
```{r, eval=FALSE}
dir.create("outputs/sam_files", recursive = TRUE)
dir.create("outputs/bam_files", recursive = TRUE)

out_files1 <- str_remove_all(out_files1, ".gz")
out_files2 <- str_remove_all(out_files2, ".gz")
meta$FileName1 <- out_files1
meta$FileName2 <- out_files2

files <- meta$FileName1
samp_names <- meta$SampleName
tryCatch({
  for (i in seq_along(files)){
    log1 <- system2(command = "hisat2",
            args = c("-x", "outputs/hisat2_index/tair10_1_index", 
                     files[i], "-p", "8", "-S", 
                     paste0("outputs/sam_files/", samp_names[i], ".sam")),
            stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE)
    
    
    log2 <- system2(command = "samtools",
            args = c("view", "-bS", paste0("outputs/sam_files/", samp_names[i], ".sam"),
                     ">", paste0("outputs/bam_files/", samp_names[i], ".bam")),
            stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE)
    
    log3 <- system2(command = "samtools",
            args = c("sort", paste0("outputs/bam_files/", samp_names[i], ".bam"), "-o",
                     paste0("outputs/bam_files/", samp_names[i], ".sorted.bam")),
            stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE)
    
    log4 <- system2(command = "samtools",
            args = c("index", paste0("outputs/bam_files/", samp_names[i], ".sorted.bam")),
            stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE)
    logs <- c(log1,log2,log3,log4)
    writeLines(logs, paste0("outputs/bam_files/", samp_names[i], "_hisat2.log"))
  }
}, error = function(e){
  paste("hisat2", "error:", e$message)
})


```
